topic.title: Basic Syntax & Data Types
topic.description: Master the fundamentals of C++ variables, types, and standard I/O.

questions.title: Variable Scope & Shadowing
questions.explanation: ::x accesses the global variable (10). The local x inside the block shadows the outer local x, so it prints 30.

questions.title: Integer Overflow
questions.explanation: Unsigned integer overflow is well-defined in C++. Adding 1 to the maximum unsigned int wraps around to 0.

questions.title: Prefix vs Postfix Increment
questions.explanation: a++ returns the original value (5) and then increments a to 6. So b=5. Then ++a increments a to 7 and returns 7. So c=7. a is now 7.
